findings.highlight: You've talked about flipping a switch in your body before, but don't do that this time.
findings.evidenceJa: この前は士郎の体にスイッチをいれようって言ってたけど、アレは止めるわ
findings.governingReading: She had proposed installing a circuit switch and now cancels that plan because making easy on/off possible would endanger him.
findings.explanation: Rin canceling her proposed switch installation becomes warning Shirou not to flip a switch.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka's palm on my chest was unbearable enough, but now something small and stick-like is under my skin, digging around inside my body...!
findings.evidenceJa: 腹に当てられた遠坂の手の平だけでも耐えられない
findings.governingReading: 腹に当てられた手 is current abdominal contact, already hard to bear; a small rodlike object passes through skin into his body.
findings.explanation: The current palm on his abdomen becomes the earlier palm on his chest, with added digging around.

findings.highlight: it'll just make Tohsaka more self-conscious
findings.evidenceJa: そんなコトをしたらますます遠坂を意識しているようで
findings.governingReading: Running away would make it look even more as though HE is conscious of Rin, leaving him no excuse.
findings.explanation: Fleeing revealing his own attraction becomes making Rin more self-conscious.

findings.governingReading: 胸張って tells him to hold his chest out for the shoulder stage of the procedure.
findings.explanation: A posture instruction becomes a resilience idiom.

findings.highlight: I'm just being weird for letting my sister get to my head!
findings.evidenceJa: 姉さんにドキマギするのおかしいですっ
findings.governingReading: As his girlfriend she says it is wrong for HIM to get flustered around her sister;39 explicitly asks him to restrain it.
findings.explanation: Sakura rebuking his fluster at her sister becomes Sakura rebuking herself.

findings.evidenceJa: 桜の視線がさっきから痛かった
findings.governingReading: 桜の視線が痛かった recalls the gaze that made him uncomfortable in6 and11; he now identifies her sulking as its reason.
findings.explanation: Her gaze painful to him becomes her looking hurt.
